_comment: Hard failures the independent audit found in the committed evidence, each with a reason and an owner. evals/plumbline_guard.py fails the build on a hard failure that is NOT listed here, and equally on a listed one that has stopped firing — a waiver for a fixed problem is a lie that accumulates. Re-baselined 2026-09-18 after golden.jsonl was re-recorded live on PR #194 (dataset d0c3a78a5db5): derived from report 514449e0478225fe, the first audit of the new recording, whose hard failures are identical to the committed report a77b9170751459ed, the same audit scored against the new baseline. Every entry was re-derived from that report rather than carried: each names the numbers it covers and the measured reason they fail, and the 2026-08-16 entries that stopped firing were deleted. This file is not a way to make the gate quiet: it is the list of things this project knows are wrong and has said so about. Shrinking it is the work.
